{{Quote|I don't know what we're going to do. Let's just hope that we're going to Piroket.|Tereb Ab'lon, to [[R2-Z1]]|<ref name="Droid Trouble" />}}
'''Piroket''' was a trading [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
Situated in the [[Piroket system/Legends|Piroket system]], Piroket<ref name="Droid Trouble" /> was located close to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="SW Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> on the edge of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was located on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] between [[A-Foroon/Legends|A-Foroon]] and the route leading towards [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and was at one end of the [[Trans Gulf Route]] leading from [[Pii/Legends|Pii]] on the opposite, western edge of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|This is Riij. Thanks for the loan of your droid. I'll leave him with the Bothan shipping company on Piroket; you can have him back when you return the freighter.|Riij Winward, on D4|<ref name="Hammertong">{{StoryCite|story=Hammertong: The Tale of the "Tonnika Sisters"|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
A motley trade world,<ref name="TEA" /> Piroket was the location of a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] shipping company,<ref name="Hammertong" /> and the world had a substantial population of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and Bothan minorities, which led to many schemes and intrigues.<ref name="TEA" /> Numerous residents and transients of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on Tatooine visited the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] from Piroket, as well as other nearby worlds such as [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="ITW SWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> The rebel [[Riij Winward]] deposited a [[D4|stolen droid]] which contained technical readouts for the [[Hammertong/Legends|Hammertong]] on the planet.<ref name="Hammertong" />

Having departed [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], Bothan [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Tereb Ab'Lon]] attempted to reach Piroket as a stop on his mission to deliver sensitive [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] information to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] at [[Tao-Grant]]. However, his [[Ambassador-class shuttle|''Ambassador''-class shuttle]] was damaged, resulting in its crash-landing on Tatooine without reaching the Piroket system.<ref name="Droid Trouble" />
